summary: Describes how to use the Elliptic Curve Digital Signature Algorithm (ECDSA) to authenticate peers in IKE and IKEv2. ECDSA can offer faster computation, smaller signatures and lower bandwidth use.

eli5.summary: To prove a letter is from you, you sign it. ECDSA is a signing method that uses a small, clever kind of math, so the signature is short and quick to check when two computers set up a secure link.
